paragraphs.text: Eigan Town ("Eternal Rock Town") is the town built around the castle of Eiganjo on Kamigawa .

Standing in the middle of the Araba , a ruined part of the Towabara Plains , Eigan Town was under the protection of the Daimyo Takeshi Konda during the Kami War . His guards would remain inside Eigan Town and only venture outside to do battle against the kami . All travel to and from Eiganjo went through Eigan Town.
It is not known if Eigan Town still exists, or if it's faded into the history of the 1,200 years since the Kami War.
